text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has begun. 
Duramente too, while being careful with her body, 
is building gradually toward the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Not the Arc de Triomphe, but the Kikuka Sho-- 
she told Kitasan Black which race she would run.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, Kitasan Black seemed to 
steel herself all over again. 
It looks like this will be a fierce summer camp.
